test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn graphs for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn graphs for structural isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
load_gtn_graph_from_text: load a gtn graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt with start and accept node format
save_gtn_graph_to_text: save a gtn graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt with node and arc details
save_and_load_gtn_graph: save a gtn graph to a binary file with gtn.save and reload it with gtn.load
